title: NRB Bearings Ltd - 530367 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: NRB Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 19.2% to INR370 crore and PAT 15% to INR38 crore; standalone PAT up 31.7%.
summary.overview: Management reported Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue of INR370 crore (vs INR310 crore) and PAT of INR38 crore (vs INR33 crore). Standalone sales grew 14.7% YoY, PAT 31.7% and EBITDA 21.7%. The call focused on the diversification push into aerospace (via the MTR/Mahant Tool acquisition), electrification, off-highway, and robotics, plus a revised FY31 revenue outlook. Management declined to give quarterly or specific FY27 guidance and repeatedly redirected questions to the longer-term track.

financial_highlights.value: Up about INR10 crore QoQ vs typical INR90-92 crore run-rate
financial_highlights.change: Attributed to power, logistics and petroleum-linked cost escalation

segments.name: Aerospace / defence (MTR, Mahant Tool Room)
segments.commentary: Acquired about a month before the call; order book about INR30 crore, with a further INR20 crore in regular non-aerospace defence (total about INR50 crore). Management projects INR300 crore revenue and INR90 crore profit contribution by 2031, though the timing was not committed.

segments.name: Industrial
segments.commentary: 14% of total revenue, up from 11%, with industrial growth of 34%.

segments.name: Heavy mobility / off-highway
segments.commentary: Accredited US defence supplier for heavy vehicles; supplies French and US defence programmes. JCB UK named as a customer at the AGM.

segments.name: Electrification / EV
segments.commentary: Management says about 70% of its applications are EV-agnostic (common to ICE, hybrid and EV). A BMW i steering product launches in 2027. Electrification vertical formed; more announcements promised in 3-6 months.

segments.name: Unitec JV (industrial cylindrical roller bearings)
segments.commentary: INR110 crore investment for INR130 crore capacity; plant to be commissioned by April 2027 at Aurangabad (Shendra) after relocating from Hyderabad. Land and a partly ready building already bought.

segments.name: NRB USA
segments.commentary: First win at Columbia, South Carolina facility: high-precision planet pins for a GM Corvette programme via a tier-1 transmission customer, about 300,000 peak volume.

guidance_outlook: FY31 revenue vision of about INR3,000 crore; management said the earlier INR2,500 crore target is too low, and that the trailing 12-month growth rate compounded gives about INR2,700-2,730 crore by FY31.
Management declined to commit to FY27 growth (analyst asked about 15-20%) and does not give quarterly guidance; company will give a fuller nominated-business update annually.
Margin guidance reiterated at 18-20% on an annual basis; management says quarterly margins may vary.
Unitec JV commissioning targeted by April 2027.
Capex: total programme INR270 crore, of which INR60 crore spent and about INR100 crore ordered or in process; management says INR100 crore of capex yields about INR130 crore of sales.
Lifetime nominated business raised to about INR1,100 crore from INR800 crore, mainly due to the US Corvette win (about USD300,000 peak volume).
capex_capacity: Total capex programme INR270 crore: INR60 crore spent, around INR100 crore ordered or being ordered, rest to follow.
Unitec JV: INR110 crore investment, INR130 crore capacity, commissioning by April 2027 at Aurangabad (Shendra); moved from Hyderabad due to logistics and cost concerns.
NRB USA (South Carolina) is a new Make-in-USA facility now receiving production orders.
Data centre bearings are in product development stage; no timeline announced.
demand_pricing: Other-expense inflation (power, logistics, petroleum-linked) addressed through value engineering (VAVE) and price increases.
Aerospace: Sukhoi-30 plain spherical bearing order cited as a breakthrough; management says only a handful of global firms make this bearing.
Robotics/humanoids and automation: customised precision components and bearings; HAAS automotive order cited.
SNL Bearings (subsidiary) is a strong contributor with lower price point; management has no concrete plan to merge it.

qa_highlights.question: Will Q1's ~19% growth continue, will FY27 close at 15-20% growth, and should the FY31 target be raised from INR2,500 crore to INR3,000 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give FY27 growth guidance and said it is conservative on guidance. It pointed to trailing 12-month growth of 14.38%, which would reach about INR2,730 crore by FY31, leaving the INR3,000 crore figure for investors to compute.

qa_highlights.question: Where will the Unitec JV plant be located, and will the INR110 crore capex be complete with commissioning by end of this financial year?
qa_highlights.answer: Commissioning is set for April 2027. The site moved from Hyderabad to Aurangabad (Shendra) over logistics and cost concerns, and a partly ready facility has already been bought. INR110 crore is the investment, with INR130 crore of capacity.

qa_highlights.question: What share of revenue is industrial, and how fast can it reach the 20-25% level previously discussed? Are EV programmes adding bearing content per vehicle versus ICE?
qa_highlights.answer: Industrial is 14% of revenue, up from 11%, with industrial growth of 34%; it is tracked annually, not quarterly. On EV, management says about 70% of applications are EV-agnostic (common to ICE, hybrid and EV). No per-vehicle revenue difference was quantified; the BMW i steering launches in 2027.

qa_highlights.question: What is the defence order book, RFQ pipeline and expected FY27 and FY31 contribution, and what capacity is being added?
qa_highlights.answer: MTR's aerospace order book is about INR30 crore, with about INR300 crore revenue and INR90 crore profit projected by 2031, timing not committed. NRB is an accredited US defence supplier for heavy vehicles and supplies French and US defence programmes.

qa_highlights.question: Why does the defence order book read INR25 crore on this call versus INR50 crore and INR70 crore cited earlier?
qa_highlights.answer: The figures are now split: about INR30 crore at MTR (aerospace) plus about INR20 crore in regular non-aerospace defence, giving about INR50 crore in total.

qa_highlights.question: Are data-centre bearings part of the Unitec JV, and how far along is the strategy? Also, how does the 12% CAGR fit with the new verticals?
qa_highlights.answer: Data-centre bearings are NRB's own product in development, not part of the JV, with no announcement yet. For the CAGR, management pointed to the trailing 12-month average of 14.28% and said the INR2,500 crore target was too low.

qa_highlights.question: What is driving the INR10 crore QoQ rise in other expenses?
qa_highlights.answer: Power, logistics and petroleum-linked cost escalation. Management said it is offsetting this through value engineering (VAVE), plant cost reduction and price increases.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the INR250-270 crore capex is spent, and how much will be deployed this year?
qa_highlights.answer: Total programme INR270 crore, of which INR60 crore is spent and about INR100 crore is ordered or in process. Management said INR100 crore of capex yields about INR130 crore of sales.

qa_highlights.question: Will margins return above 20% as in the past, and has the core team of Mahant Tool Room been retained?
qa_highlights.answer: Margin guidance is kept at 18-20% on an annual basis; quarters may vary. On retention, management said MTR's leader Mr. Mallappa now heads the aerospace defence segment and that talent retention was a reason for the deal.

qa_highlights.question: Has the lifetime nominated business risen from INR800 crore, which new platforms were won, and will MTR contribute revenue in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Lifetime nominated business is now about INR1,100 crore, driven by the US Corvette win (about 300,000 peak volume). On FY27 MTR revenue, management said yes but declined to quantify, citing difficulty predicting aerospace timing.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a plan to merge SNL Bearings into NRB?
qa_highlights.answer: No concrete plan to merge. SNL is described as a strong contributor with a lower price point, serving the replacement market and industrial, two-wheeler and agricultural applications.

qa_highlights.question: What products will NRB supply to robotics and humanoid makers?
qa_highlights.answer: Customised precision components (such as shafts and housings) plus bearing combinations, developed with customers' designs. Management cited the HAAS automotive order and said each order is around 250,000 units.

risks_watch: Unitec JV commissioning by April 2027 at Aurangabad; any slip given cited slowdowns in global supply chains.
Other-expense inflation (power, logistics, petroleum) and whether VAVE and price increases offset it; margin band stays 18-20% annually.
Conversion of the about INR50 crore defence order book and the MTR aerospace INR300 crore by 2031 target, with timing uncommitted.
Capex execution: INR270 crore programme, INR60 crore spent, about INR100 crore ordered or in process; ramp of NRB USA Corvette planet-pin orders.
Guidance gap: management gave no FY27 growth number and no quarterly guidance, and FY31 target is framed as a vision (about INR2,700-3,000 crore), so the revised target may be hard to track.
Disclosure consistency: defence order-book and nominated-business figures were restated during the call (INR50/70 crore; INR800 crore vs USD300,000), so expect clarity requests next quarter.
key_quotes: So it's more a question of not whether it's going to be INR20 crores this year, but whether this year's INR20 crores will become INR100 crores next year.
Is INR2,500 crores too low? Definitely it looks like lower than we're going to achieve, for sure.
We have a combination of VAVE, which is, value engineering and cost reduction in the plants and price increases to deal with this.
summary.management_tone: Confident on strategy and the long-term track (diversification, aerospace, electrification, FY31 vision), but cautious and evasive on near-term numbers: it declined FY27 growth, quarterly guidance and the aerospace revenue timing, and redirected several questions to the trailing 12-month baseline.
